value: \.hlsl:\d+:\d+: error: shader must include inout payload structure parameter
note: The symptom is the DXIL half of the reported disagreement: DXC's DXIL back end rejects the empty payload. The message is emitted from tools/clang/lib/CodeGen/CGHLSLMS.cpp:2497, which is on the DXIL code-generation path only -- the SPIR-V back end (SpirvEmitter) cannot produce it -- so it cannot be satisfied by the second, SPIR-V invocation captured in the same output file. The `<file>:<line>:<col>: error:` prefix is required so the match is a diagnostic attributed to a source file rather than the string appearing anywhere in a dump; the filename itself is deliberately NOT pinned, so a control run against a different shader can still fire the predicate and is therefore a real test of it. Positive-only on purpose. The predicate does NOT also require the SPIR-V compile to succeed, for two reasons: (1) v1.4.1907 has no SPIR-V code generation at all and answers `SPIR-V CodeGen not available`, which is a feature-absence marker -- had the SPIR-V success been part of the predicate, that release would have scored no-repro and been demoted to invalid-probe, discarding a DXIL result that is perfectly valid; (2) an absence or success clause about the SPIR-V half would be satisfiable for free by a run that never got that far. The SPIR-V side is evidence, recorded in the same capture and read by hand, not part of the scoring. Exit status is deliberately not used: dxc returns E_FAIL (0x80004005) for every ordinary diagnosed error, and this error is an ordinary diagnosed error, not an internal failure. Control: control-nonempty-payload.hlsl -- the identical miss shader with one float4 field -- must NOT match (variant-control-nonempty-*.txt).
